### Observed differences

- In the later window, activities A19, A20 and A25 occur later in traces (mean position rises from about 0.33 to 0.59, 0.34 to 0.58, and 0.31 to 0.59 respectively), while A26 and A27 occur slightly earlier (A26 from 0.352 to 0.324, A27 from 0.581 to 0.554). [POS001, POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005]
- The order between A26/A27 and A19/A20/A25 reversed: before, A19/A20/A25 preceded A26/A27 in about 30–38% of traces; after, A26/A27 precede them in about 30–36% of traces. [REL001, REL002, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007]
- Successor changes: A19, A20 and A25 previously went to A26 in 89–98% of outgoing transitions; now they go to A28 and A32 (A19: A28 51%, A32 46%; A20: A28 51%, A32 43%; A25: A28 38%, A32 58%). A27 previously went to A28 in 98% of transitions; now it goes to A20, A25, A19 and A28 (17.5%, 14.5%, 15.5%, 51%). A28 previously went to A32 in 94% of transitions; now it goes to A32 48%, A25 22%, A19 14%, A20 15%. A45 previously went to A19/A20/A25 (31%, 26%, 28%); now it goes to A26 in 89%. [DIR001–DIR006]
- Lag changes: A25–A26 changed from immediate adjacency (lag 1) to being five steps apart; A45–A26 changed from two steps apart to immediate adjacency. [LAG003, LAG008]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a reversal in the order of a group of activities: A26 and A27 now occur before A19, A20 and A25, whereas before they occurred after them. This is directly shown by the reversal of the A-before-B / B-before-A shares in the REL items, the shift of A19/A20/A25 to later positions and A26/A27 to earlier positions, and the successor changes in which A19/A20/A25 no longer lead to A26 but to A28/A32, while A45 now leads to A26 instead of to A19/A20/A25. The evidence is consistent across DIR, REL, POS and LAG indicators, and the number of qualifying items (27) far exceeds the 0.63 expected by chance. A limitation is that the full process structure is not specified, so the exact position of A28 and A32 relative to the reversed group is only partially captured, but the core order reversal is well supported.

Other differences: The successor distribution of A28 broadened from a dominant A32 to a mix of A32, A25, A19 and A20, and A27 now branches to several activities instead of a single A28. These are consistent with the same reordering rather than an independent change.
